characters.identity_anchors: Elderly thin man; pointed nose; shrivelled cheek; stiffened gait; red-rimmed eyes; thin blue-tinged lips; frosty white rime on head, eyebrows and wiry chin; hard sharp flint-like features; cold self-contained solitary bearing; often carries low personal temperature in posture and expression.
characters.source_evidence: P25: squeezing wrenching grasping scraping clutching covetous old sinner; hard and sharp as flint; cold within froze old features, nipped pointed nose, shrivelled cheek, stiffened gait; eyes red, thin lips blue; frosty rime on head eyebrows wiry chin. P26-P28 solitary, iced office, avoided even by blind men's dogs.
characters.voice_label: grating cold elderly male; caustic then later warm broken with emotion

wardrobe_variants.description: Dark severe day clothes of a City moneylender; great-coat buttoned to the chin when outdoors; sombre waistcoat and breeches; no ornament; severe practical winter layers against fog and frost.
source_facts: P96 buttoning his great-coat to the chin
P25 tight-fisted hand at the grind-stone
P29 sat busy in counting-house Christmas Eve
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Muted black/charcoal wool, high collar, worn but meticulously kept; no colour or cheer; thin frame emphasised by severe cut.

wardrobe_variants.description: Dressing-gown, slippers and nightcap; prepares gruel by low fire; later double-locked in chambers.
source_facts: P108 took off cravat; put on dressing-gown and slippers and nightcap; sat down before the fire to take his gruel
P107 small fire; spoon and basin; little saucepan of gruel
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Faded dark dressing-gown, plain nightcap, worn slippers; sparse domestic night look matching gloomy chambers.

wardrobe_variants.description: Solitary neglected schoolboy; reading alone near feeble fire in bare schoolroom; later greeted by little sister Fan.
source_facts: P244 solitary child neglected by friends left at school
P247 lonely boy reading near feeble fire
P260 little girl much younger addressed him as dear brother
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Plain worn schoolboy clothes of early 19th century; thin, lonely, undersized for age; no luxury.

wardrobe_variants.description: Young man apprentice at Fezziwig's; brisk with fellow-'prentice Dick; joins Christmas Eve warehouse ball.
source_facts: P280 Scrooge's former self now grown a young man came briskly in accompanied by fellow-'prentice
P275 Was I apprenticed here
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Simple apprentice waistcoat and shirtsleeves suitable for warehouse work then dancing; youthful energy before avarice sets in.

wardrobe_variants.description: Man in prime of life; face beginning to wear signs of care and avarice; eager greedy restless eye; seated with fair young girl in mourning-dress.
source_facts: P303 older now man in prime of life; face begun to wear signs of care and avarice; eager greedy restless motion in the eye
P304 sat by side of fair young girl in mourning-dress
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Respectable dark City clothes of rising man of business; still handsome but hardening; contrast with Belle's simplicity.

wardrobe_variants.description: Best clothes; glowing laughing crying; light as feather; later early at office in accustomed clothes but transformed manner.
source_facts: P696 dressed himself all in his best
P667 as light as a feather happy as an angel merry as a schoolboy
P697 walking with hands behind him regarded every one with delighted smile
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Same silhouette as counting-house clothes but fresher, better brushed, open cheerful posture; Christmas morning brightness in face and step.

characters.identity_anchors: Transparent ghost of Scrooge's dead partner; same face as in life; pigtail; ghostly spectacles turned up on forehead; livid colour; death-cold eyes; lower jaw that can drop to breast when bandage removed; body see-through so coat buttons visible behind.
characters.source_evidence: P100 Marley's face dismal light like bad lobster; spectacles on forehead; hair curiously stirred; eyes wide open motionless; livid. P116 same face pigtail usual waistcoat tights boots; chain clasped about middle of cash-boxes keys padlocks ledgers deeds heavy purses; body transparent. P142 bandage off jaw dropped.
characters.voice_label: hollow sepulchral male; Marley's voice no doubt; cries of remorse

wardrobe_variants.description: Pigtail, usual waistcoat, tights and boots with bristling tassels; coat-skirts; folded kerchief/bandage bound about head and chin; long heavy chain wound about middle like a tail made of cash-boxes, keys, padlocks, ledgers, deeds and steel purses; transparent throughout.
source_facts: P116 Marley in pigtail usual waistcoat tights and boots; tassels bristling; chain of cash-boxes keys padlocks ledgers deeds heavy purses wrought in steel; body transparent
P118 folded kerchief bound about head and chin
P142 taking off the bandage round its head jaw dropped
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Spectral blue-livid skin; chain dull iron and brass with ledger and cash-box links clearly readable as business tools; hair and skirts agitated as by hot vapour; infernal atmosphere of own.

characters.identity_anchors: Thin underpaid clerk; threadbare clothes; long white comforter; mild cheerful father; carries Tiny Tim on shoulder; darned brushed garments made to look seasonable.
characters.source_evidence: P30 clerk in dismal little cell Tank copying letters; white comforter; tried to warm at candle. P62 fifteen shillings a week wife and family. P97 long ends of white comforter dangling; no great-coat; ran home to Camden Town. P395 little Bob threadbare clothes darned up and brushed; Tiny Tim upon his shoulder; three feet of comforter exclusive of fringe.
characters.voice_label: mild warm lower-middle London clerk; tremulous with feeling for Tim

wardrobe_variants.description: Threadbare clerk's clothes; long white comforter dangling below waist; no great-coat; perched on stool in Tank with tiny fire.
source_facts: P30 white comforter tried to warm himself at the candle
P97 long ends of his white comforter dangling below his waist for he boasted no great-coat
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Faded ink-stained dark coat, thin waistcoat, darned elbows; comforter the only warmth splash of off-white.

wardrobe_variants.description: Threadbare clothes darned and brushed to look seasonable; at least three feet of comforter exclusive of fringe; carries Tiny Tim; later mourning quiet.
source_facts: P395 threadbare clothes darned up and brushed to look seasonable; Tiny Tim upon his shoulder; comforter exclusive of the fringe
P613 little Bob in his comforter
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Same poor suit brushed; comforter prominent; Christmas Day modest dignity; later subdued mourning layers same clothes.

characters.identity_anchors: Scrooge's nephew; young adult male; ruddy handsome face; sparkling eyes; cheerful glowing from cold walk; hearty contagious laugh; kind persistent good humour.
characters.source_evidence: P31 cheerful voice Scrooge's nephew. P33 heated with rapid walking in fog and frost all in a glow; face ruddy and handsome; eyes sparkled; breath smoked. P442 hearty laugh recognised as nephew's. P443 man more blest in a laugh.
characters.voice_label: warm hearty young gentleman; laughing easily

wardrobe_variants.description: Outdoor winter clothes suitable for rapid walking in fog and frost; cheerful nephew calling on uncle in counting-house.
source_facts: P33 heated himself with rapid walking in the fog and frost; all in a glow
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Good middle-class winter coat, scarf, gloves; healthy colour from cold; open friendly appearance opposite Scrooge.

wardrobe_variants.description: Festive evening clothes at own bright dry gleaming dining-room party; host of games music and toast.
source_facts: P441 bright dry gleaming room
P454 clustered round the fire by lamplight with dessert
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Smart but not ostentatious evening wear; warm indoor layers; laughing host energy.

characters.identity_anchors: Strange figure like a child yet not so like a child as like an old man viewed through supernatural medium diminished to child's proportions; white hair as if with age but unwrinkled face with tenderest bloom; long muscular arms and hands; delicately formed bare legs and feet; bright clear jet of light springing from crown of head; fluctuates in distinctness (one arm, one leg, twenty legs, head without body).
characters.source_evidence: P213 strange figure like a child yet like old man diminished; hair white as age yet face no wrinkle tenderest bloom; arms long muscular hands same; legs feet delicately formed bare; tunic purest white; lustrous belt; branch fresh green holly; dress trimmed summer flowers; jet of light from crown; extinguisher cap under arm. P214 fluctuated distinctness.
characters.voice_label: soft gentle singularly low as if at a distance

wardrobe_variants.description: Tunic of purest white; lustrous sparkling belt; dress trimmed with summer flowers in contradiction of wintry holly branch held in hand; great extinguisher cap held under arm; bare limbs; light from head.
source_facts: P213 tunic of the purest white; lustrous belt; branch of fresh green holly; dress trimmed with summer flowers; extinguisher for a cap which it now held under its arm; jet of light from crown
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Ethereal white fabric catching own head-light; flowers vivid against holly; cap large conical extinguisher; body parts can dissolve and reform in gloom.

characters.identity_anchors: Jolly Giant glorious to see; dark brown long free curls; genial face sparkling eye open hand cheery voice unconstrained demeanour joyful air; bare capacious breast; bare feet; ages to grey hair by end of night.
characters.source_evidence: P350 jolly Giant glorious to see; glowing torch shape not unlike Plenty's horn. P354 clothed in one simple green robe or mantle bordered with white fur; capacious breast bare; feet bare; holly wreath set with shining icicles; dark brown curls long and free; genial face sparkling eye open hand cheery voice; antique scabbard no sword eaten with rust. P476 Ghost grew older hair grey.
characters.voice_label: cheery booming genial giant; later sorrowful when showing Ignorance and Want

wardrobe_variants.description: Simple green robe or mantle bordered with white fur hanging loosely bare breast; bare feet; holly wreath with icicles on head; antique rusted empty scabbard girded; holds glowing torch like Plenty's horn; later hair greys; two wretched children emerge from robe folds.
source_facts: P354 green robe or mantle bordered with white fur; breast bare; feet bare; holly wreath shining icicles; scabbard eaten up with rust
P350 glowing torch
P483-P484 from foldings of its robe two children
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Rich holly green velvet-like robe with thick white fur edge; monumental cheerful bulk; torch casts ruddy blessing light; scabbard visibly empty and rusted; children yellow meagre ragged wolfish when revealed.

characters.display_name: Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come
characters.identity_anchors: Tall stately Phantom; shrouded in deep black garment concealing head face form; nothing visible save one outstretched hand; mysterious presence fills solemn dread; silent; does not speak.
characters.source_evidence: P495 Phantom slowly gravely silently approached; scatter gloom and mystery. P496 shrouded in deep black garment concealed head face form left nothing visible save one outstretched hand. P497 tall and stately; mysterious presence solemn dread; neither spoke nor moved.

wardrobe_variants.description: Deep black garment/hooded shroud concealing all but one outstretched pointing hand; merges with night; dress bears Scrooge along.
source_facts: P496 deep black garment which concealed its head its face its form and left nothing of it visible save one outstretched hand
P507 followed in the shadow of its dress which bore him up
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Featureless black void of fabric; hand pale skeletal or gloved in black; movement slow grave; no face ever revealed; towering over Scrooge.

characters.identity_anchors: Very young crippled boy; little crutch; limbs supported by iron frame; withered little hand; thoughtful; plaintive little voice; fragile light to carry.
characters.source_evidence: P395 Alas for Tiny Tim he bore a little crutch and had his limbs supported by an iron frame. P401 as good as gold; hoped people saw him in church because he was a cripple. P413 God bless us every one. P414 withered little hand. P612 very light to carry.

wardrobe_variants.description: Poor child's clothes; little crutch; iron frame supporting limbs; carried on Bob's shoulder; later absent (vacant seat) or remembered in mourning.
source_facts: P395 little crutch; limbs supported by an iron frame
P414 sat very close to father's side upon little stool; withered little hand
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Patched but clean poor boy clothes; visible brace/crutch; pale delicate face; small stature emphasised.

characters.identity_anchors: Bob's wife; dressed poorly but brave in ribbons; proud loving mother; resents Scrooge; capable housekeeper of goose and pudding.
characters.source_evidence: P387 dressed out but poorly in a twice-turned gown but brave in ribbons which are cheap and make a goodly show for sixpence. P423 wish I had him here I'd give him a piece of my mind; odious stingy hard unfeeling man. P405 made the gravy; P407 pudding like speckled cannon-ball.
characters.voice_label: brisk warm working-class mother; sharp when naming Scrooge

wardrobe_variants.description: Twice-turned gown poor but brave in cheap ribbons; apron for cooking; later sewing mourning things for Tim.
source_facts: P387 poorly in a twice-turned gown but brave in ribbons
P600 mother and daughters engaged in sewing
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Faded turned dress with bright ribbon trim for Christmas show; practical apron; flushed from cooking; later subdued same gown for mourning.

characters.identity_anchors: Fair young woman; gentle steady; later comely matron with daughter; released Scrooge when gold became his idol.
characters.source_evidence: P304 fair young girl in a mourning-dress; eyes tears. P305 another idol has displaced me; golden one. P329 beautiful young girl so like that last until saw her now a comely matron sitting opposite her daughter.

wardrobe_variants.description: Mourning-dress; fair young girl releasing Scrooge from engagement.
source_facts: P304 fair young girl in a mourning-dress
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Simple dark mourning gown of modest means; no jewellery; dignified restraint.

wardrobe_variants.description: Comely matron in comfortable modest home; winter fire; surrounded by noisy happy children; daughter beside her.
source_facts: P329 comely matron sitting opposite her daughter; room full of comfort; more children than Scrooge could count
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Warm modest matron dress; domestic comfort; maternal glow opposite earlier mourning.

characters.identity_anchors: Old gentleman; Welsh wig; capacious waistcoat; comfortable oily rich fat jovial voice; laughs all over himself from shoes to organ of benevolence; wonderful agility; calves shine like moons in dance.
characters.source_evidence: P276 old gentleman in a Welsh wig sitting behind such a high desk. P278 rubbed hands; adjusted capacious waistcoat; laughed all over himself from his shoes to his organ of benevolence; comfortable oily rich fat jovial voice. P288 positive light appeared to issue from Fezziwig's calves; shone like moons; cut so deftly appeared to wink with his legs.
characters.voice_label: comfortable oily rich fat jovial elderly master

wardrobe_variants.description: Welsh wig; capacious waistcoat; clothes of prosperous jovial warehouse master; dances Sir Roger de Coverley with Mrs Fezziwig.
source_facts: P276 Welsh wig
P278 capacious waistcoat
P288 Fezziwig cut so deftly
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Bright prosperous 18th/early 19th merchant clothes; full waistcoat; wig slightly askew with energy; infectious physical comedy in dance.

characters.identity_anchors: Little girl much younger than boy Scrooge; tiny hands; delicate creature a breath might have withered; large heart; mother of Fred.
characters.source_evidence: P260 little girl much younger than the boy came darting in putting her arms about his neck often kissing him dear dear brother. P261 bring you home. P267 always a delicate creature whom a breath might have withered but she had a large heart. P271 Your nephew.

wardrobe_variants.description: Child's winter travel clothes; little girl arriving by coach to fetch brother from school for Christmas.
source_facts: P260 little girl much younger
P263 sent me in a coach to bring you
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Simple period girl's cloak and dress; small stature; glowing with affection.

characters.identity_anchors: Two portly gentlemen pleasant to behold; books and papers; hats off; seeking provision for Poor and destitute at festive season.
characters.source_evidence: P63 two other people in; portly gentlemen pleasant to behold; stood with their hats off; books and papers in their hands bowed. P68 at this festive season more than usually desirable slight provision for the Poor and destitute.

wardrobe_variants.description: Respectable outdoor coats; hats (held off); credentials and subscription books/papers in hands.
source_facts: P63 portly gentlemen pleasant to behold; hats off; books and papers
P66 presenting his credentials
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Dark respectable City coats of the period; well-fed pleasant faces; one slightly leading; later same men met on Christmas morning for donation.

characters.identity_anchors: Grey-haired rascal nearly seventy; smokes pipe; deals in iron old rags bottles bones greasy offal; screens himself with frousy tattered curtain; calm luxury of retirement among wares.
characters.source_evidence: P536 grey-haired rascal nearly seventy years of age; screened from cold by frousy curtaining of miscellaneous tatters; smoked his pipe in all the luxury of calm retirement. P539 old Joe removing his pipe.

wardrobe_variants.description: Ragged warm layers of a marine-store/fence dealer; pipe; among heaps of rusty metal and rags.
source_facts: P536 grey-haired rascal nearly seventy; frousy curtaining of miscellaneous tatters; smoked his pipe
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Greasy layered waistcoat and coat; fingerless gloves optional; calculating eyes; charcoal stove glow on face.

characters.identity_anchors: Laundress; one of three scavengers selling dead man's effects; bold; practical about stripping corpse.
characters.source_evidence: P538 let the laundress alone to be the second. P542 What odds then What odds Mrs. Dilber. P553 Mrs. Dilber was next; sheets and towels little wearing apparel two old-fashioned silver teaspoons sugar-tongs few boots.

wardrobe_variants.description: Poor working woman's outdoor clothes; heavy bundle of scavenged sheets towels apparel; bold defiant manner in Old Joe's parlour.
source_facts: P538 laundress
P541 woman who had already spoken threw her bundle on the floor sat down in a flaunting manner
P553 sheets and towels little wearing apparel
wardrobe_variants.creative_direction: Faded shawl and worn dress of laundress; bundle prominent; unapologetic posture.

locations.source_evidence: P24 name stood years afterwards above warehouse door Scrooge and Marley. P29-P30 door open to keep eye on clerk; Scrooge very small fire; clerk's fire one coal; coal-box in master's room. P89 hour of shutting up.

open door to dismal little cell beyond (the Tank)

next morning Boxing Day ordinary office light

locations.source_evidence: P30 clerk who in a dismal little cell beyond a sort of tank was copying letters; fire so very much smaller it looked like one coal.

lighting_states: cold daylight from small window if any

locations.image_brief: Fog-choked Victorian London court and streets; biting cold; phantom opposite houses; cheerful shop light fighting gloom.

sitting-room with low fire and Dutch-tile fireplace

disused bell communicating to highest story
lighting_states: dying flame leap at Marley's entry
Christmas morning clear bright from window
locations.image_brief: Gloomy suite once Marley's; sparse mean comfort; Dutch tiles; low fire; heavy door; wide dark stair; atmosphere of long neglect and cold.

locations.source_evidence: P98 lived in chambers which had once belonged to his deceased partner; gloomy suite.
layout_anchors: same as Scrooge's chambers - inherited suite

locations.canonical_name: country road and market-town of Scrooge's boyhood
locations.source_evidence: P233 open country road fields either hand; city vanished; clear cold winter day snow upon ground. P241 every gate post tree; little market-town in distance bridge church winding river; shaggy ponies boys country gigs carts.
locations.image_brief: Bright cold snowy countryside of memory; merry boys on ponies; town with church and bridge in distance; contrast to London fog.

layout_anchors: dull red brick mansion cupola bell
long bare schoolroom deal forms desks
best-parlour maps globes waxy with cold

locations.source_evidence: P274 certain warehouse door. P276 old gentleman high desk almost to ceiling. P282 shutters up. layout_anchors: door for father and porter with toys
stairs to upper rooms where children subside

locations.source_evidence: P365 city streets Christmas morning; severe weather; people scraping snow pavement and roofs; boys artificial snow-storms. lighting_states: sullen red sunset then darkest night
